summary: Iteration 16 — 5 MEDIUM polish fixes on Batch C+D. Mongo cleanup + localStorage.clear each session; Playwright mobile 390x844 at https://no-changes-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com; login as alex+test1@jaleter.app / password123. BACKEND smoke: POST /api/auth/login and GET /api/coaching/bookings both 200 OK. FRONTEND: F1 App Lock text-node warning — FULL PASS. Opened settings-applock configure sheet, ran full PIN dance (1-2-3-4 → cfg-pin-continue → 1-2-3-4 → cfg-pin-continue to save). Zero 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' console messages fired during the sheet lifecycle (0/0). Only pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents warnings remained. F2 Settings row immediate refresh + Change/Turn off flow — FULL PASS. Before PIN save: label 'Not set / Tap to set a PIN'. Immediately after cfg-pin-continue (Save PIN) fired, WITHOUT re-navigating, settings-applock row flipped to 'Enabled / PIN only' with lock icon (verified via inner_text). Tapping the row a second time opened the sheet with title exactly 'Change App Lock' (Set up App Lock text NOT present) and cfg-pin-disable ('Turn off App Lock') button visible at the bottom. Cleanup: tapped Turn off → row returned to 'Not set / Tap to set a PIN'. F3 TxForm category/subcategory picker — FULL PASS. All requested testIDs render: tx-type / tx-type-expense / tx-type-income / tx-name / tx-amount / tx-date / tx-month + tx-month-{Jan..Dec} (12 pills, horizontal scroll) / tx-group-{give,steward,grow,enjoy} / tx-sub-{tithe,missions,extra-giving,...}. Selecting tx-group-give flipped subcategory list to Tithe/Missions/Extra Giving (expense flow). Filled type=expense, name='Sunday offering', amount=300, tx-month-Jul, tx-group-give, tx-sub-tithe → tx-save. Went to Budget → Jul → Give (expanded by default) → Tithe row shows actual/budgeted = '$300 / $0' proving the manual expense correctly attached to Give/Tithe/Jul (the '$0' budgeted is only because Tithe monthly budget was never set in that run — the tx itself landed on the correct subcategory bucket). Screenshot f3_txform.png shows the full sheet with Category chips (Give/Steward/Grow/Enjoy) and Subcategory chips (Tithe/Missions/Extra Giving) visible below the Month row. F4 Add Subcategory sheet testIDs — FULL PASS. Tapping budget-sub-add-give opened the sheet. All three requested testIDs present and interactive: sub-add-name, sub-add-amount, sub-add-save. Filled name='Test Sub' + amount=50 → sub-add-save. New 'Test Sub' subcategory appears in the Give group with row '$0 / $50 · tap to set'. F5 Alert badge — PARTIAL / NOT-AUTOMATION-VERIFIABLE. Prereq worked: alert-tithe-p50 chip enabled in Settings, master toggle already ON, master settings-alerts row present. TxForm F3 flow proved a $300 Tithe/Jul expense attributed correctly. HOWEVER, the automated flow to set Tithe monthly budget to $500 via tapping budget-sub-tithe → filling budget-edit-amount → budget-edit-save could not complete because the edit sheet's TextInput was not addressable at the moment the automation queried it — page.query_selector('[data-testid="budget-edit-amount"]') returned null immediately after the tap (the RN Sheet's autoFocus TextInput takes longer to mount than the 1s wait, or the tap on the row was intercepted by an overlapping ScrollView gesture in RN-Web). Because Tithe budget stayed at $0, spct = a/b = infinity and the badge branch is `b>0 && spct>=threshold`, so no badge renders. The BADGE CODE ITSELF is correct — /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:1260-1286 shows the exact logic (spct = b>0 ? a/b*100 : 0; alertLevel = exceeded|p80|p50 based on alerts.perCategory[sub.id] chips; alertColor = red|amber|champagne-gold; badge renders 'OVER'|'80%'|'50%' text). Recommend main agent self-verify F5 by manually setting Tithe budget=$500 via the UI or by seeding categories via localStorage. Cross-screen regressions — FULL PASS. Budget still has budget-view-cards + budget-view-grid toggles, budget-add-category and budget-export buttons, all 12 tx-month pills, all Jan..Dec + Year budget-period pills. Legacy tab: all 7 timeframe pills present (1yr, 2yr, 3yr, 5yr, 10yr, 20yr, Retirement). Coaching (More → Book Coaching): cal-prev / cal-next arrows present, calendar view intact. NO red console errors during any of the flows (0 non-deprecation errors) — only the recurring shadow* / pointerEvents RN-Web deprecation warnings. Cleanup: App Lock disabled at end of F2. Mongo linked_accounts / bank_transactions / coaching_bookings / payment_transactions all cleared. Locally-added transactions live only in localStorage (jaleter-state-v2) and are cleared on next localStorage.clear() session.
